{{Quote|Have you forgotten that ''one'' Jedi Knight is worth a ''thousand'' battle droids?''"<br />"''Hey, Gunner&mdash;did someone award her a ''field promotion'' while my back was turned? She was only a ''Padawan'' when we left camp.|Ahsoka Tano and Sarge|<ref name="Night Moves" />}}
'''Sarge''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Sarge served under [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and alongside [[Gunner (501st Legion)|Gunner]] during a [[Battle of Zeenada|battle]] on [[Zeenada]].<ref name="Night Moves" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
Sarge wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|blue]] markings. Sarge's armor had designs of jagged lines on the shoulders, chest, and [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="Night Moves" />
